notes.executionRules: The index impl-plans/active/document-page-images.md 'Shared execution rules' are binding: all workers on branch main in one working directory; no git write commands, worktrees or branches by workers; fresh read plus pre/post shasum -a 256 per edited file recorded in the worker's own plan Progress Log; edit only own writePaths; sharedPaths are read-only unless a sharedPathNotes entry says otherwise; never touch .riela/, the index (except P10), other plans' files, lockfiles; no broad formatters.
notes.evidenceLayout: Evidence lives under the untracked, gitignored evidenceRoot tmp/document-page-images, one subdirectory per plan short id (P1..P10) as the plans specify. A re-run after a failed attempt writes into tmp/document-page-images/<P#>/attempt-<n>/ and keeps earlier logs. Create directories with mkdir -p first; tee does not create them.
notes.shell: Verification commands use bash-only ${PIPESTATUS[0]}; run them under bash (they are wrapped in bash -c). A blank exit= is not evidence. Tests need PKG_CONFIG_PATH=$PWD/.build/anydoc-native/host/pkgconfig; run mise run build once first.
notes.peerBreaks: Concurrent wave-2 workers share one .build. A compile failure in a file outside the worker's writePaths owned by another in-flight plan is not edited; retry up to 3 times, then record 'blocked by peer <planId>' (not passed) for P10 to re-run.
notes.commitPolicy: AGENTS.md governs commits: no emojis, no machine-local absolute paths, no secrets, no downloaded PDFs or real recognized text. .riela/ is untracked and never committed; tmp/ is gitignored. Workers do not commit; P10 does not commit, push or archive plans; workflow finalization owns that.

reviewContext.issueReference: No GitHub issue. Inline workflowInput 'PDF pages: show deterministic page images only; OCR text is search/RAG-only; agent Q&A uses page image + RAG context' (workflow opus-luna-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-242; plan review accepted in comm-003161, Step 4 output comm-003160).
reviewContext.userProblem: kaiba OCRs PDFs and images into Markdown that the user reads, and the web reader offers a confusing Text/Original toggle. The user wants to read PDF and image imports only as deterministic page images, keep OCR text solely for search and RAG, and ask the agent about the page they are viewing with the page image plus retrieved related text.
requiredOutcomes: Document page notebooks (PDF pages and standalone images) render page images only; no Text/Original toggle and no 'Page display mode' group in web/ (DP1).

OCR text moves to hidden server-internal notes.search_text; page bodies are ''; FTS, LIKE search, snippets, fusion, tagging, agent tools and notebook previews read one retrieval-text function (DP2, DP4).

Schema version 22 migration moves existing page bodies into search_text in one idempotent transaction; versions 19/20/21 upgrade through 21 to 22; existing notebooks keep images and searchability (DP5).
Manual/deferred per-page OCR updates only search_text, title, documentPage metadata and FTS; body writes and undo/redo body deltas on page notes are refused (DP3, DP6).
Rasterization stays deterministic PDFKit/CoreGraphics code with determinism tests; figure extraction and import.figures are dropped (DP7).

Agent chat on a page sends exactly one page origin image (<= 3,750,000 bytes, allowed media types) plus page OCR, neighbour OCR and up to 6 retrieved windows within a fixed budget, scoped to the conversation library and acting user (DP8, I5, I6).

Image transport for agent-gateway (mirroring ImageOCRDocumentConverter vendor matrix incl. Claude subscription), Anthropic Messages and OpenAI chat completions; text fallback notice for vendors without image support and openai-compatible (DP9).
GraphQL SDL, KaibaClient types and web DocumentPageMetadata unchanged; new semantic contract tests (DP10).
Non-PDF/non-image imports and normal notes unchanged, with a regression test; mise run check passes.
nonGoals: Changing import or rendering of EPUB, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, OpenDocument, RTF, CSV, HTML, Markdown, text or other heading-split formats.
Embedding models, vector stores or LLM calls at index time.
Sending adjacent page images, re-rasterizing at another resolution, or downscaling oversize standalone images.
Model-level vision detection or automatic text-only retry.
Exposing search_text through GraphQL, KaibaClient or the CLI.
constraints: Only PDF and standalone image imports switch to the page-image model; all other formats and user-authored notes stay Markdown exactly as today.
Rasterization must be deterministic code; no agent/LLM in the image path; no provider output stored as source-page-image (I4).
Swift files under 1000 lines; existing SwiftPM target boundaries; swiftlint (mise run lint) after Swift edits; no emojis.
Never print or commit secrets; no downloaded PDFs or real recognized text; synthetic fixtures only.
Do not touch the untracked .riela/ directory or unrelated files.
web/ server-credential rule tests must keep passing; run mise run web:check and mise run tauri:check when web/ changes.
designDecisionsAndRationale: DP2: dedicated nullable notes.search_text column (last column) instead of bodyMarkdown or metaJSON, so OCR is hidden yet indexed and non-page notes keep NULL.
Retrieval text is one function of (body_markdown, search_text) used by every consumer, so FTS insert and contentless-delete replay stay byte-identical.
DP3: body writes on page notes throw 'document page text is managed by OCR; use a comment to annotate the page'; comments are the annotation path.
DP5: one-way migration on first open, pure SQLite, single transaction; upgradeToVersion21 records literal 21 so a crash cannot mark an unmigrated store as 22.
DP6: undo snapshots carry searchText; legacy snapshots are normalized with the same transform as the migration; applyNoteBodyDelta refuses page notes.
DP7: page images already show figures, so figure extraction is removed; previously attached figure files stay attached but unshown.
DP8: one image only, neighbours as OCR text, top-6 retrieved windows of 1,500 chars, subject OCR bounded to 8,000 chars; note edit mode is disabled for page subjects.
DP9: vision support decided per provider, not per model; gateway transport mirrors the live-verified ImageOCRDocumentConverter.performConversion matrix.
DP10: no SDL change, so older clients keep working.
intentionalTradeoffs: Text a user typed into a page note before upgrade becomes hidden search/RAG text rather than being deleted.
A vision-incapable model under an image-capable provider fails the turn with the provider error; no automatic retry.
openai-compatible credentials always use the text fallback.
An older web client against a new server sees empty Text views but working Original views.
Transitional cross-wave test failures are expected; only P10's full check is authoritative.
supportedEdgeCases: Pending pages store search_text '' (not NULL) and are skipped by the migration selector.
Migration is idempotent; a store with the column already present still migrates; version 23 is rejected as unsupported future.
Deferred OCR on a migrated page with existing search text prepends the recognized text.
Standalone PNG import follows the page model, including a maximumOCRPages: 0 pending variant.
Oversize (> 3,750,000 bytes) or unsupported media type origin, or missing origin file: no image, explicit notice line in context.
Retrieval excludes other libraries and agent-conversation notebooks; empty or punctuation-only queries produce no retrieval section.
Requests without images are byte-identical to today for gateway argv/stdin and tool-loop request bodies.
Legacy undo snapshots without a searchText key restore with the migration transform; non-page snapshots restore with search_text NULL.
Config JSON containing import.figures still decodes.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Notebook translation of page-image notebooks (receives empty bodies for now).
residualRisksFromPlanReview: P7 no-image byte-identity test is partly tautological; explicit no --image / stream-json / -- assertions guard it.
P7 vendor table says 'served' but the converter uses executionMode != .local (covers subscription); mirror the converter exactly.
P8 'memberwise init' wording: UserAgentToolLoopRunner has an explicit init; add a defaulted supportsImageInput parameter there.
P3 standalone-image test references a fixture in a test P3 replaces; read the fixture before replacing it.
